records.title: AdmTree: Compressing Lengthy Context with Adaptive Semantic Trees
records.reason: Abstract states quadratic self-attention cost limits long-context LLMs and proposes adaptive hierarchical compression using semantic trees and gist tokens with a frozen backbone/lightweight aggregation. This directly reduces inference context cost while preserving semantic content.

records.title: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: The abstract identifies repeated target-model forward passes as the closed-loop latency bottleneck in autoregressive VLA policies and adds world-aware prefill to speculative decoding; it reports 1.5x matched-success speedup. The deployment domain is robotics/VLA, but the concrete method is LLM-style speculative inference acceleration.

records.title: EntropyPrune: Matrix Entropy Guided Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract targets MLLM inference cost from hundreds of visual tokens per image, selecting a pruning layer with matrix entropy and pruning redundant visual tokens; it reports FLOP reduction while retaining benchmark performance. This is a direct multimodal inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Adaptive Ensemble Self-Distillation With Consistent Gradients for Fast Inference of Pretrained Language Models
records.reason: The pinned worklist supplies a stable DOI and title, but the official DOI resolver returned an internal error and the exact-title query did not expose an IEEE primary abstract. With abstract-level relevance unverified, retain as borderline rather than accepting from the title.

records.title: Recurrent Context Compression: Efficiently Expanding the Context Window of LLM
records.reason: The abstract says recurrent context compression expands LLM context under compute and bounded-memory constraints, with compression up to 32x and reduced storage in long-text inference. This directly addresses inference memory/context capacity.

records.title: Parallel Vision Token Scheduling for Fast and Accurate Multimodal LMMs Inference
records.reason: The abstract presents training-free parallel scheduling of subject/non-subject visual tokens, dropping one path mid-inference; reports up to 88.9% token pruning, 1.77x speedup and 70% FLOP reduction in MLLMs.

records.title: Elbert: Fast Albert with Confidence-Window Based Early Exit
records.reason: The abstract identifies slow inference as a resource constraint for pretrained language models and proposes confidence-window early exit for ALBERT, reporting 2x–10x adaptive inference speedup with negligible accuracy degradation. This is a concrete language-model inference efficiency technique.

records.title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models
records.reason: The abstract studies RWKV-7 delta-rule recurrent models with fixed-size O(1) inference memory and extreme contexts, then proposes chunk-boundary state compression to avoid numerical failure while retaining reasoning. It is directly relevant to long-context recurrent LLM inference stability and memory.

records.title: Cassandra: Enabling Reasoning LLMs at Edge via Self-Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The abstract proposes training-free self-speculative decoding for low-batch edge inference, using pruning and mantissa truncation for draft generation and hardware support to reduce conversion overhead; it reports up to 2.41x speedup and more tokens per memory budget.

records.title: HELIOS: Adaptive Model And Early-Exit Selection for Efficient LLM Inference Serving
records.reason: The abstract describes multi-model early-exit selection and loading only likely-to-be-used layers to reduce token latency and memory use, then reuse memory savings for larger serving batches. This is a direct inference-serving optimization.

records.title: SpecOffload: Unlocking Latent GPU Capacity for LLM Inference on Resource-Constrained Devices
records.reason: The pinned worklist supplies the DOI/title. The DOI resolver and direct IEEE Xplore document page did not expose a primary abstract in this session, so the strong title-level inference lead is retained as borderline pending primary abstract verification.

records.title: Computational Challenges in Token Economics: Bridging Economic Theory and AI System Design
records.reason: The abstract explicitly frames computational feasibility in real-time LLM inference, including low-latency execution, uncertain resource allocation, and economic-aware system architecture. Although it outlines a research agenda rather than a complete method, it is concretely within inference-system design and is retained broadly for downstream reading.

records.title: XY-Serve: End-to-End Versatile Production Serving for Dynamic LLM Workloads
records.reason: The pinned worklist provides DOI/title and the title indicates serving scope, but the official ACM DOI page could not be retrieved and no ACM primary abstract was available from the official page in this session. Do not accept from the title alone; retain as borderline with identity and retrieval limitation.

records.title: Fast Cross-Operator Optimization of Attention Dataflow
records.reason: The abstract treats attention as a dominant Transformer/LLM compute kernel and proposes cross-operator dataflow enumeration to optimize accelerator execution; it reports 31–69% latency reductions and much faster design-space exploration. This is directly relevant to inference kernels and hardware.

records.title: ExpertWeave: Efficiently Serving Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuned Adapters at Scale
records.reason: The abstract describes serving multiple MoE expert-specialized adapters over a shared base model using virtual-memory-assisted expert placement and fused rerouting; it targets accelerator memory and throughput, reporting higher KV-cache capacity and throughput.

records.title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
records.reason: The abstract proposes dual-path low-bit quantization for MLA KV caches, offline-fusible transforms and a native low-bit attention kernel; it targets cache memory that scales with context and batch size while preserving model quality.

records.title: PulseCol: Periodically Refreshed Column-Sparse Attention for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The abstract targets repeated full-attention cost in diffusion LLM inference and proposes reusable, periodically refreshed column-sparse attention patterns, improving sparsity and practical speedup while maintaining model quality.
